channel.title: Delivrie changelog
channel.description: New features and fixes in Delivrie.

item.title: Docs, legal pages and client logos
item.guid: Nov 12, 2026-Docs, legal pages and client logos
item.description: A new docs site with a page for every API endpoint, the MCP server guide and a changelog. Terms, Privacy, DPA, Acceptable Use, Cookies, Subprocessors and Security pages. Official logos for Claude, Cursor, v0, Codex, Antigravity and VS Code in the Works with sections.

item.title: New pricing, credits and billing
item.description: Pro includes 20,000 emails a month and Scale 100,000, with yearly plans at ten months’ price. Paid plans keep sending past their allowance and pay overage per 1,000 at month end. Set a spending cap in Billing. Pay-as-you-go credits from ₦5,000 or $5 that never expire, and a marketing add-on priced by contacts.

item.title: Test addresses and natural-language scheduling
item.description: Send to delivered@, bounced@ and complained@test.delivrie.io to test events without touching your reputation. scheduled_at accepts phrases like “in 1 hour” and “tomorrow at 9am”.

item.title: Sign in with Google, GitHub or a code
item.guid: Nov 12, 2026-Sign in with Google, GitHub or a code
item.description: Google and GitHub sign-in. Sign-up, sign-in and password reset use 6-digit codes instead of magic links.

item.title: Delivrie is live
item.description: Transactional email over a REST API, broadcasts, templates, contacts, domains, webhooks and logs. A hosted MCP server with 24 tools for AI agents.
